name: form-wizard
title: Form Wizard
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A form in steps, in a dialog or on a page (a new customer, an onboarding). `FormWizard` takes `steps` (`{ title, description }` per step) and the current step, controlled (`step`/`onStepChange`) or not (`defaultStep`). It's a react-aria `Form` whose submit is Next, so Enter advances and the current step's fields validate natively (only that step is mounted); then `onNext(step)` runs — validate or save there (react-hook-form's `trigger`); returning `false` or throwing keeps the user on the step and a promise shows Next as pending. Finish runs `onNext` of the last step and then `onComplete`. `FormWizardSteps` is the `stepper` list: earlier steps are reachable, later ones only through Next; titles show when the wizard is wide enough for that many steps, and narrower only the numbers, with the current title under them (container query). `FormWizardStep` holds a step's fields; after Back or Next, focus moves to its first field. `FormWizardFooter` shows the progress ("Step 2 of 4", announced politely), `children` before Back (a dialog's Cancel), Back and Next/Finish. The values stay in the app; with react-hook-form, keep `shouldUnregister` off. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`.
